summary: Frontend-only smoke test of the Bahia Stay vacation rental site. Home page, destination/amenity/price filters, property detail pages (ps-01, il-02, ar-04), booking widget with weekly + first-booking discounts, WhatsApp checkout URL (number 5511981389572 verified), OpenStreetMap iframe embed, floating WhatsApp button, and navbar brand navigation all work correctly. No console errors observed.
passed: Home page loads with navbar, filter sidebar, destination tabs, 10 property cards, promo badges, and footer
Destination tabs filter correctly: all=10, porto-seguro=3, ilheus=3, arraial-d-ajuda=4 (results-count label updates)
Amenity filter 'Piscina' narrows to 5 houses; combined with 'Ar-condicionado' = 5; filter-clear-btn resets to 10
Price range slider renders bounds R$ 300 — R$ 1500 (Chalé Araçaípe R$ 300 confirmed lowest)

Property detail /casa/ps-01 shows title 'Casa Mirante Taperapuã', gallery, badges, and amenities list containing 'Ar-condicionado', 'TV', 'Fogão', 'Geladeira', 'Wi-Fi', 'Piscina', 'Churrasqueira', 'Estacionamento', 'Cozinha equipada', 'Vista para o mar'
property-modal-leaflet-map iframe src is https://www.openstreetmap.org/export/embed.html with bbox and marker=-16.418,-39.059 matching property coords

Booking widget: 7 nights × R$780 = R$5.460 → Pacote Semana aplicado R$2.800 (property-modal-weekly-discount-badge appears); toggling first-booking adds -10% → R$2.520 (property-modal-first-booking-discount-badge appears); booking-total updates correctly
WhatsApp checkout opens https://wa.me/5511981389572?text=... in new tab with property title, check-in, check-out, guests, nights, subtotal, weekly discount, 10% first-booking discount, and total
Clicking checkout without dates shows toast error 'Selecione as datas de check-in e check-out'
floating-whatsapp-btn opens wa.me URL with number 5511981389572
il-02 (Loft Cacau & Mar) and ar-04 (Villa Tropical Ajuda) detail pages load with map and no console errors
No console errors / pageerrors observed on home and 3 detail pages

failed.issue: Review spec mentions `property-card-1` style (numeric), but also references `property-card-ps-01` style elsewhere. Actual code uses numeric indices (property-card-1 .. property-card-10). Not a bug, just a doc/spec inconsistency; functionality works and cards are clickable.

Review spec references booking-checkin-input / booking-checkout-input, but actual testids are `booking-checkin` and `booking-checkout`. Inputs function correctly; purely a naming mismatch to flag for consistency.
failed.evidence: Enumeration on /casa/ps-01 lists booking-checkin and booking-checkout (type=INPUT); no *-input variants exist.

action_items: Optional: align data-testid names with the review spec (property-card-<id>, booking-checkin-input, booking-checkout-input) for easier automated verification, or update the spec. Core functionality already works.
